title: Abbas Main Tanha Hu
body:
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Saahil Ki Taraf Dekh Ke Bole Shah-e-Wala
1.Tum Jabse Gaye Bhai Todhti Hai Kamar Meri
Dhundhala Gayi Akber Ke Jaane Se Nazar Meri
Ab Koun Mujhe Bolo Aada Se Bachayenga
<<MINI>>
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Tum Lakhou Pe Bhaari They Aaye Jaan-o-Dil-e-Hyder
Har Rukhse Tane Tanha Shabbir Ke They Lashkar
Is Alam-e-Gurbat Me Ab Koi Nahin Mera
<<MINI>>
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Amma Ne Meri Mujhku Sopa Tha Bhai
Mamoor Hifazath Par Rakha Tha Tumhe Bhai
Tum Par Meri Amma Ku Is Darja Bharosa Tha
<<MINI>>
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Cheenega Sakina Ke Kaanou Se Laayen Ghouhar
Marenga Tamache bhi Bachi Ku Meri Khudsar
Tum Honge Na Main Honga Us Waqt Mere Bhaiya
<<MINI>>
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Mehmaan Hu Kuch Dum Ka Maidan-e-Shujayath Me
Kat jayenga Sar Mera Ab Sajde Ki Halat Me
Hojayanga Ab Pura Bachpan Ka Mera Wada
<<MINI>>
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Uthta Hai Sarou Se Jo Abbas Karam Teera
Aafat Me Musibath Me Hai Alhe Haram Bhaiya
Ab Koun Mere Ghar Ku Jalne Se Bachayenga
<<MINI>>
Abbas Main Tanha Hu Abbas Main Tanha Hu
